newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: No U.S. rate hike seen buoying Australia stocks.
newsitem.headline: No U.S. rate hike seen buoying Australia stocks.

text.p: *Stocks seen firmer on relief over no U.S. rate hike, Dow rise. Resources seen bolstered by strong metals. "It will be reasonably positive, maybe up 10-15 points," said one dealer.
*Dow jumps 75 in late trade after Fed announces no rate hike, U.S. focus now turns to July 1-2 FOMC meeting
*ADRs: News Corp 18 (+1/8), BHP 30 1/4 (+7/8), WMC 25 5/8 (+1/8), National Australia Bank 69-1/8 (+3/4)

*Copper prices jumped overnight, closing in London up US$19 a tonne at 2,493. Nickel prices dropped US$165 to 7,690. Gold firms US$1.50 on Comex to US$343.40 after Germany says it has no plans to sell gold reserves. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
